about: Hand review of every word where the engine (rules only, treebank record off) and the Quranic Treebank / Quranic Corpus disagree, every 40th ayah. Buckets: engine = our mistake or a blank; valid = a position the i'rab books hold, or the same analysis labelled another way; corpus = the key is off (odd label, labels one piece of a joined word, hides a مقدّر case, or names the same role differently); context = needs the ayah before.

2:34|فَسَجَدُوا: إذ is no condition here; سجدوا is a plain verb, not جواب الشرط
2:154|أَمْوَاتٌ: خبر of a left-out مبتدأ (هم أموات)
